answer: The Quill bond registry stops Sybil swarms with locked stake: every new agent must lock a 2,500 POA Quill bond for 14 epochs before it can earn, held in a Glacier escrow that releases only after two clean grading cycles. A Relic audit key signs each bond once, so one bond cannot be reused across identities and fake agents cannot borrow stake from each other. Forging 2,000 identities locks 5,000,000 POA for 14 epochs and risks losing it all to slashing, so an attacker pays millions in frozen capital before earning a single reward.
